_comment: Committed PDK + tool defaults for the layout evidence under layout/.
This is the layout-verification sibling of design/pdk.json and
sim/pdk.json -- deliberately a SEPARATE file, per design/pdk.json's own
comment block precedent ('when a harness lands it brings its own
pdk.json'). open_pdks_commit below MUST match design/pdk.json's and
sim/pdk.json's exactly -- verified 2026-09-05, all three read
c6d73a35f524070e85faff4a6a9eef49553ebc2b.
variant           sky130 flavor directory used to generate/verify
every layout/ evidence directory below
open_pdks_commit  provenance pin, matches design/pdk.json + sim/pdk.json
klt_deck          the klayout-tools (`klt`) rule-deck name resolved for
this PDK family (--deck sky130 on every klt drc /
klt extract / klt lvs invocation under layout/)
klt_version_pin   the klt build this evidence was last generated/
verified against, from `klt version --format json`.
A provenance pin, not a hard gate, same as
open_pdks_commit above -- re-verifying with a
different klt is expected to happen and should update
this pin plus the affected evidence directories
together. NOTE the pin has moved BACKWARDS in
package-version order (0.4.0 -> 0.3.0+gc6dbf66c53c6):
the installed klt build genuinely churns between
sessions in this environment, so treat this field as
'what actually produced the committed evidence', not
as a monotonic version floor. Each artifact carries
its own provenance.klt_version, which is the
authoritative per-file record. The churn has since
been observed MID-SESSION and as a downgrade to
0.2.0, which lacks the blocks[].cell request shape
every layout/ro_ring5* cell depends on -- see
layout/README.md's 'Correcting the curation note'
for the one-command venv recipe that pins the
version below independently of whatever the shared
tool install currently holds.
layout/sampler_dff exception (issue #106): this pin's own build
(0.3.0+gc6dbf66c53c6, PR #1479) and every ambient
0.4.0-tagged release (git_commit 34548dc) predate
connectivity[].legs[] support (klayout-tools
#1529/#1536) entirely -- no _parse_legs function.
layout/sampler_dff/cell.json's own clkb_seg2 stage
requests legs[], so composing it against either
build fails deterministically with 'error:
clkb_seg2: nets left unrouted by gen-compose:
[clkb_mid]'. That is NOT recipe drift (confirmed:
the unmodified recipe reproduces byte-for-byte once
klt supports legs[]) and NOT a new tool bug (the
prior silent-wrong-route failure mode for this exact
gap was klayout-tools #1548, already CLOSED/fixed --
today's hard 'nets left unrouted' error is that fix
working as intended for a version-incompatible
request). This one directory therefore needs a
*newer* klt than the shared pin above to reproduce:
see layout/sampler_dff/README.md's 'Reproducing
this cell's own --check' for the exact commit and
venv recipe. The shared pin above is deliberately
left unmoved -- several other evidence directories
(layout/pex*, layout/ro_array_core*) document
reproducing against this exact value, and bumping it
fleet-wide is out of this issue's scope.
ci_klt_install    what .github/workflows/pdk-nightly.yml's layout-check
job actually installs, per issue #36. klt_version_pin
above (a dev snapshot, 'g<hash>' suffix) has no PyPI
artifact -- klayout-tools is only published at tagged
releases (0.1.0-0.5.0 as of 2026-09-17) -- so CI pins
to the latest *tagged* PyPI release instead of trying
to reproduce the exact dev-snapshot commit. The
mid-session churn described above is a shared,
persistent dev-environment failure mode (a long-lived
`uv`-managed tool install mutating between commands);
it does not apply to CI, which does one fresh,
explicitly-versioned `pip install` per job run and
then never touches the install again. The pin is
the wrong side of the layout/sampler_dff exception
documented just above -- it predates
connectivity[].legs[] (klayout-tools #1529/#1536), so
layout/sampler_dff/cell.json fails --check against it
with 'error: clkb_seg2: nets left unrouted by
gen-compose: [clkb_mid]', and layout-check pinned to
0.4.0 would be red on main for a reason that is not
drift. Verified 2026-09-17: klt 0.5.0 from PyPI,
against the open_pdks commit pinned below,
reproduces all nineteen committed layout/*/cell.json
cells' evidence exactly -- sampler_dff included, and
including ro_ring5's blocks[].cell hierarchical
composition (the request shape 0.2.0 lacks). Same
'provenance pin, not a hard gate' status as
open_pdks_commit/klt_version_pin above -- if a future
PyPI release makes layout-check fail against
otherwise unchanged committed evidence, that is real
signal (klt regressed against this repo's evidence,
exactly the klayout-tools#1491 failure mode), not a
config bug to silence. Bumping it is a deliberate,
re-verified edit, the same contract klt_version_pin
above carries. Deliberately still 0.5.0 -- not
signoff-check grader pin moved to 0.6.0 alone (the
grader is a pure JSON transform), while this pin
gates the nineteen committed cells' compose-cell
--check reproductions and 0.6.0 changed
gen-compose's via-drop/tap-role handling
(klayout-tools#2312), so bumping it requires a
full --check re-verification first. The divergence
between the two pins is deliberate.
REGENERATION, issue #181 (2026-10-07): klt_version_pin and
ci_klt_install now both name the exact klayout-tools
source commit 5edb557f91d0116368c386617802ec727b4bdc90
(klayout-tools PR #2778, the fix for #2648: sky130
cut centres snapped onto the 0.005 um grid, and cuts
drawn at sky130's fixed sizes -- licon/mcon 0.17 um,
via1 0.15 um -- instead of the PDK-generic 0.22 um).
No tagged release contains that commit (v0.6.0 is
490 commits behind it), so both pins are the source
commit, not a PyPI version. All nineteen
layout/*/cell.json cells were regenerated bottom-up
on it (klt 0.6.0+g5edb557f91d0, KLayout 0.30.12,
open_pdks c6d73a35f524..., curated sky130 deck
content_hash sha256:2bcbd625a0e3...); each is
DRC-clean on that deck and LVS-matching with
unchanged device/net counts. The older pins above
(0.3.0+gc6dbf66c53c6 / 0.5.0) regenerate the
pre-#181 geometry (5664 licon1.ongrid.1 + 198
via.width.1 findings on sampler_core under the
current deck) while their own older decks still
report clean -- which is exactly why the nightly
must not stay on 0.5.0: its --check would go green
while rebuilding the defective geometry.
